name: Shokushu Ningen ~Osananajimi Hen~
source:
Once every 97 years, the Tentacle Tree bears fruit. 
It grows densely along the back property of the Rupee family. 
From childhood the legend is told, but no one could confirm it was true. 

These are the adventures of a hero who ate that fruit. 
Its transformative powers made him a human monster. 
You are that hero! You are... Tentacleman! 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE063330.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
每97年，触手树就会结果一次。
它沿着卢比家族的后院茂密生长。
这个传说从小就流传，但没有人能证实它的真实性。

这是一个吃了那个果实的英雄的冒险经历。
它的变革力量使他成为人类怪物。
你就是那个英雄！你是……触手人！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE063330.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
